skill.name: video-inpainting
skill.description: Use RunComfy CLI workflows to edit selected regions across video frames. The skill helps remove or replace objects and choose a model route for prompt-driven, identity-stable, or frame-by-frame edits.
skill.summary: Edit selected video regions across frames with RunComfy model routes.
skill.author: doany-ai

security_audit.summary: Static command, network, filesystem, and reconnaissance hits are false positives from Markdown formatting, documentation links, and security notes. No prompt injection attempt or hidden code execution was found, but normal use sends video edit data to RunComfy and includes watermark removal guidance that needs rights-aware safeguards.

remediation.suggestion: Ask for confirmation before sending sensitive video URLs or prompts to RunComfy, and document data handling expectations clearly.

remediation.issue: Watermark and logo removal can be misused
remediation.suggestion: Require the user to confirm ownership or explicit permission before assisting with watermark or logo removal.

remediation.issue: CLI setup examples can be misread as broad shell permission
remediation.suggestion: Keep the allowed tool scope limited to Bash(runcomfy *) and avoid adding arbitrary shell or remote install script steps.

content.value_statement: Video region edits can fail when objects move across frames. This skill routes the task to RunComfy video inpainting workflows and gives clear prompt guidance.
actual_capabilities: Selects RunComfy model routes for prompt-driven video region edits.
Guides object removal or replacement across multiple video frames.
Provides prompt wording for spatial regions and preservation instructions.
Identifies when ComfyUI workflows are better for mask-based inpainting.
Explains RunComfy CLI setup, sign-in, output handling, and exit codes.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and a valid RunComfy account or token.
Prompt-driven routes do not provide exact pixel-level mask control.
Long clips and complex motion can reduce temporal consistency.
Media is processed by RunComfy services, not only on the local machine.

use_cases.title: Clean Licensed Footage
use_cases.description: Remove a temporary object, cable, or background distraction from footage you own or are authorized to edit.

use_cases.title: Test Product Region Changes
use_cases.description: Replace a simple product area in a short clip while preserving motion and surrounding content.

use_cases.title: Choose an Inpainting Route
use_cases.description: Compare Wan, Lucy, Seedream, and ComfyUI options before running a video region edit.

prompt_templates.title: Remove One Object
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a simple licensed clip cleanup.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use video-inpainting on this video URL. Remove the small object near the lower left across all frames. Preserve all other content.

prompt_templates.title: Replace a Region
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for one moving object replacement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit the selected video region with RunComfy. Replace the red cup on the table with a blue cup. Keep lighting and motion consistent.

prompt_templates.title: Pick the Best Route
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt when model choice is uncertain.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this video edit request and choose the best RunComfy route. Explain whether Wan, Lucy, Seedream, or ComfyUI fits best.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Mask-Level Work
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for precise region control.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a video inpainting workflow for exact mask propagation. Include route choice, expected quality checks, and when to use ComfyUI.

output_examples.input: Remove a boom microphone from a short licensed scene.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends Wan 2-7 Edit-Video, gives a focused preservation prompt, and explains where the edited result will be saved.

output_examples.input: Replace a moving product box in a social clip.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests a single-change edit pass, warns about drift, and recommends follow-up review for motion consistency.

output_examples.input: Need exact mask tracking for a person crossing the frame.
output_examples.output: The skill explains that prompt routing is not enough and points to a ComfyUI workflow with mask propagation.

best_practices: Use only media you own or have clear permission to edit.
Describe one region and one edit per run for better consistency.
Use ComfyUI workflows when exact masks or temporal tracking are required.
anti_patterns: Do not remove watermarks or logos from media without authorization.
Do not combine many unrelated edits in one prompt-driven run.
Do not treat prompt-only edits as pixel-accurate mask propagation.

faq.question: Does this create videos from scratch?
faq.answer: No. It edits regions inside an existing video clip.

faq.question: Does it require RunComfy?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill uses the RunComfy CLI and RunComfy hosted model routes.

faq.question: Can it use exact masks?
faq.answer: The main CLI routes are prompt-driven. Use ComfyUI workflows for exact mask propagation.

faq.question: What data leaves my machine?
faq.answer: Video URLs, prompts, and generated outputs are processed through RunComfy services.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Can it remove a watermark?
faq.answer: Only use that capability on media you own or have explicit rights to edit.
